text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hello there, I'm Super Creek. Hehe, let's take good care of each other.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh, my dream? Well… What's yours, Trainer? Because my dream's to make yours come true! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Don't be shy now, you can tell me! Letting me pamper you a whole bunch is more than enough to make me happy, after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
